title: 15-year-old pickleball champ Tama Shimabukuro to play in Manila exhibition
summary: Fifteen-year-old pickleball world champion Tama Shimabukuro is set to join world No. 1 Anna Leigh Waters and other international stars at a major pickleball exhibition in Manila on December 9.
